assets.caption: Figure 5.1 Density 100 kg/m³ down to 5 kg/m³
assets.notes: Full-page nomograph/chart for pressure drop in steam pipes. Includes embedded formula and density/C value lookup table within the figure. X-axis: specific volume (m³/kg), Y-axis: pressure drop per 100 m (kPa/100m), with diagonal lines for pipe diameter and steam velocity. Small table of density vs correction factor C embedded in lower-left of chart area.
